result.summary: The page is largely well-structured, with clear hierarchy, consistent cards, and a readable bottom navigation. The main visual defect is a nonsensical '-0%' discount badge on the pizza card. A minor redundancy also appears in the delivery-fee labels. Clipped carousel items and the cut-off card at the bottom were excluded as intended behavior.

issues.description: The pizza restaurant card displays a '-0%' discount badge, which is meaningless and looks like a data or formatting error.
issues.suggestion: Hide the discount badge when the discount is zero, or show a meaningful promotion label only when a real discount exists.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows free delivery twice: once in the '€0 delivery' badge on the image and again in the metadata line '25–35 min • €0 delivery • Ramen'.
issues.suggestion: Remove the duplicate delivery fee from either the image badge or the metadata line to reduce clutter.
